description: This file defines server-side logic for loading and updating organization settings in a SvelteKit application. It contains a load function to fetch settings from an API and an actions object with an update method to send modifications back to the API.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads organization settings from the backend API using cookies for authentication.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles form submission to update organization settings via API PATCH request; returns success or error result.
